verdict.rationale: The CRA's own pages say online registration (Business Registration Online, BRO) is the fastest way to get a business number. In one form, founders can also open GST/HST, payroll and corporation income tax accounts, and the e-services pages cover filing returns and making payments online. Minor caveats are that GST/HST registration via BRO excludes Quebec, and some filing runs through certified EFILE software. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the online registration, filing and payment flows complete end-to-end.
